references.text: Also deals with vow offerings and voluntary offerings of cattle that must be without defect to be accepted by the Lord.
Describes burnt offerings of cattle that must be without defect and presented at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
Introduces the rules for peace offerings (שְׁלָמִים) of cattle to the Lord.
Deals with vow offerings (נֶדֶר) and voluntary offerings, the same type of offering mentioned in this text.
Earlier in the same chapter, the context introduces fire offerings of cattle or sheep as vow offerings or voluntary offerings.
Mentions burnt offerings, slaughter offerings, vow offerings, and voluntary offerings that must be brought to the place the Lord chooses.
The psalmist promises to come to God's house with burnt offerings and fulfill his vows to the Lord.
